reviews.text: Trusted for years! Very good and very kind.

They're excellent at grooming and cutting. I have a golden retriever who comes out beautiful, soft, and smells amazing.
They're the best!

When I'm in Milan, Pelo & Contropelo is my go-to shop for stocking up on canned food and dry food for our cat Nina. Previously, it was just a stone's throw from my house, but the new location is still very convenient, just steps from the M5 Istria station, and easier parking if you arrive by car. Added value, in addition to the quality and variety of products, is Mrs. Roberta's courtesy and expertise.

I had an appointment to have my cat groomed on April 13th at 3 pm. I showed up, but the shop was closed and no one answered the phone. I don't know what happened, but at least they could have let me know, since I'm on work leave. I can't describe this behavior.
Beautiful, refined and accurate grooming, many products for our furry friends, a place where my dog ​​feels good and if he likes it that says it all

Professional, welcoming, and super competitive prices.
Highly recommended.

Lagotto Romagnolo cut.
Happy dog, helpful and very kind.
OLIVER is a difficult Maltese to handle. I'm amazed that when I take him to Roberta, he's always calm and feels at home. Roberta is sweet and capable. In an hour, he's beautiful and smells great.
